data: Does the red dashed line have a much larger steep slope than the black line?

The red dashed line has a steeper slope than the black line. The red dashed line starts at approximately 1 on the y-axis and decreases sharply towards -1, while the black line also decreases but more gradually. Therefore, the red dashed line has a much larger steep slope than the black line.
